regions.name: Mempawah
regions.quote: Endemic to Borneo, with Indonesian records from the Kapuas and Mempawah rivers in Kalimantan Barat (West Kalimantan) province, Maruwei, Pembuang, Teweh, and Kahayan watersheds in Kalimantan Tengah (Central Kalimantan), plus the Negara and Jorong drainages in Kalimantan Selatan (South Kalimantan).
